reading: Pornhub is a website that is being investigated.
A regulator called Ofcom is checking the website's age system.
Ofcom worries that children can still see adult content online.
Pornhub uses a system from Apple to check user ages.
But Ofcom thinks this new system may not work well.
Websites with adult content must use strong age checks.
Companies can pay a large fine if they do not follow the rules.
